caption: The drawing depicts a single large wooden trunk with a curved lid, reinforced by dark metal bands and brass rivets. The trunk is depicted in perspective, angled so that both the front and side are visible. The wood of the trunk is rendered in shades of brown, showing the texture and grain, while the metal bands and hardware—such as hinges, handles, and a central lock—are colored in darker grays and brass tones. The edges and corners of the trunk are marked by additional metal reinforcement. The trunk has a leather handle on the visible side and two leather straps crossing from the backside to the front, secured by brass buckles. It is situated against a plain, off-white background, and a fine-lined red border frames the image, with a small inscription in the lower right corner.
title: Trunk
